post.summary: Set the invited account password and activate administrator access
post.description: Exact approved Origin, trusted ingress network, existing registration identity/network quotas, nonce-scoped invitation attempt protection, strict 4 KiB JSON and UUID Idempotency-Key are required. The strong active unexpired mailed invitation is one-time, purpose-bound mailbox enrollment proof. Only a new or enabled UNASSIGNED identity without external identities, active MFA, platform profile/history or tenant ties may enroll. Existing unfinished password identities may choose their activation password; established accounts are never reset. Saved names/email/role come only from the locked invitation. Password hashing, email verification, old challenge invalidation, epoch advancement, session revocation, profile/role creation, invitation consumption and minimal audit/outbox evidence commit in one transaction. No login session or MFA assurance is created. After 204 navigate to ordinary login. Matching idempotent replay does not rewrite credentials; changed-password replay is rejected. Proof-bound idempotency uses the secret invitation capability as an HMAC key, never a persisted fast password hash.

token.description: Strong scoped invitation capability or legacy opaque token; bare six digits are never sufficient.

password.description: Must satisfy the current server-owned password policy; confirmation remains client-only.

204.description: Password enrollment and invitation activation committed, or identical command replay. No session/CSRF cookies; continue to login.

400.description: Invalid input or password policy failure

409.description: Invitation expired, used, replaced, cancelled, identity ineligible or request conflicted; no partial credential/role writes

429.description: Existing identity/network or invitation-proof controls enforced

503.description: Activation unavailable or unconfirmed; never a fake success
